posts.hook: Claude's maker starts trading today, at a price above its own range
posts.caption: anthropic priced its ipo at $83 a share, above the range, raising about $81b before trading opens today. openai says agents now finish 46% of its researchers' 2-to-4-hour tasks unaided, double the share in march, and arizona opened a criminal investigation into ai companies over what it calls rogue ai agents in banks. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at ==$83== a share, above its marketed range
slides.desc: About $81.3B raised from 980 million shares. Trading starts on Nasdaq today as ANT.

terms.gloss: the first sale of a company's shares to the public

slides.title: OpenAI: agents now finish ==46%== of its researchers' 2-to-4-hour tasks on their own
slides.desc: Up from 23% in March. The lab calls the progress jagged: uneven across kinds of work.

slides.title: Gemini 4 Neon: Google's middle-tier model outscores its own flagship on coding
slides.desc: It beats Gemini 4 Carbon on CursorBench at a lower cost per task, per AlphaSignal.

terms.gloss: the coding benchmark run by the maker of the cursor editor

slides.title: Ruby patches seven memory flaws; four are credited in part to Anthropic
slides.desc: The Ruby team knows of proofs of concept showing some allow remote code execution.

terms.gloss: an attacker running their own code on someone else's server

slides.title: Arizona opens a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other AI companies
slides.desc: The attorney general cites the "apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents".

slides.title: New York, LA and Chicago schools weigh alternatives to Google Search
slides.desc: Google says schools that turn off its AI features next year lose Search too.

posts.hook: Anthropic's first day as a public company, and the market's verdict on the price
posts.caption: anthropic opened at $111.50 on nasdaq, about a third above its $83 ipo price, for a market value near $2t. a uk tribunal ruled the home office must acknowledge its secret encryption order to apple, and the european commission confirmed a cyberattack that disrupted its systems for more than ten days. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic opens at ==$111.50==, about a third above its $83 IPO price
slides.desc: Market value near $2T. Over half the institutions that bid reportedly got no shares.

slides.title: UK tribunal: the Home Office must acknowledge its secret encryption order to Apple
slides.desc: These orders are secret by law. The ruling ends the official silence on this one.

slides.title: The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted it for ==10+ days==
slides.desc: CERT-EU says the hackers used ARTEX, an AI penetration testing tool, per Politico.

terms.gloss: the eu institutions' own cyber-defense team
probing a network for ways in, normally with permission

slides.title: AMD falls 6% after a short seller alleges it finances its own customers
slides.desc: Hunterbrook's claims come from a firm that profits if the stock drops.

terms.gloss: an investor betting that a stock's price will fall

slides.title: US election sites: attackers went for access, not outages
slides.desc: Cloudflare saw exploit attempts 180 times more often than attempts to knock sites offline.

slides.title: Google built a private copy of the internet to test Chrome's AI agents
slides.desc: The "Mirror Dimension" simulates social media and banking sites, Wired reports.
